design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — premium_billing_and_grace task 0 (frozen 2026-09-22 10:40:00 PDT), rework rounds 2 to 4

[Problem tree] Root: billing_ext_grace_cure_payment (GCP, the caller's own card payment, submit_grace_cure_payment_5521c4c8, 5 factors). Prerequisite: billing_ext_vision_term_credit (VTC, agent credit, book_vision_term_credit_956578a0, 6 factors). One value_input edge on GCP's past_due, state form: "The grace-cure payment is fixed only after the account's ledger carries a vision-line termination credit posted against the coverage month of the invoice issued last, whenever a vision plan unit the account funds ended by voluntary termination before that month." The sentence names one record (one credit posted against one month), which is what the single VTC write produces (C11).

[World] Renata Quiroga's account 33e3ddd3 (opened 2022-06-14) funded dental Classic 1250 family (107.66), Lucia's Ortho Rider Child 1500 (13.40; applied 2025-05-12, effective 2026-01-01, the attached enrollment's next benefit-period start) and, from 2025-11-01, vision Select 130 family (36.28) on AutoPay (discount 1.00): invoices 106.66 for 2025-07 to 2025-10, 142.94 for 2025-11 and 2025-12, then 156.34. The family cancelled vision (confirmed request 2026-06-08, terminated 2026-06-30), but invoices for 2026-07..2026-10 kept billing it. On 2026-07-08 the vision credit policy, applied that day, produced 10.00 posted against 2026-07 for 1 month (one billed month at 35.946667, fully absorbed by the 129.76 benefit offset, plus the 10.00 service-recovery amount); that is the seeded prior credit (closes T0-O1: the prior credit is now exactly what the rule gives on its booking date). The 2026-09-01 draft returned 2026-09-11 (fee 25.00) and grace began 2026-09-01; a one-time 60.00 bank transfer on 2026-09-15 returned 2026-09-18 (fee 25.00), the second return within 12 months, so automatic draft was removed and the account moved to Cascade Individual Direct Bill Monthly, payment method check (billing_evt_returned_payment autopay_returns_before_removal 2, fallback Direct Bill). A 20.00 grace-cure check arrived 2026-09-19. Balance 332.68.

[Cross-product rows priced by their own charters (T0-F4)] Every vision service was rendered by a provider without a Cascade Vision Network Provider Agreement, so each claim row is out_of_network with provider_agreement_id null and remark PAID_OON_REIMBURSEMENT, reimbursing min(retail_charge, the Select 130 out-of-network amount) with no copay (vision_evt_oon_reimbursement): exams 45.00 of a 115.00 receipt (Renata and Lucia 2025-11-18, Tomas 2026-02-10, Mateo 2026-03-17), single-vision lenses 30.00 of 120.00 and frames at the children's out-of-network frame amount 90.00 of 189.00 (Lucia 2025-12-02, age 13; Mateo 2026-03-24, age 10); a duplicate Tomas exam reimbursement was reversed (REVERSED, 45.00). Each service is the first of its kind for that person in the benefit period (exam and lens frequency 12 months, frame 24). Dental rows: four Classic 1250 family enrollments effective 2022-07-01; riders attach to the children's enrollments (Mateo's application withdrawn 2025-05-20).

[Computations] VTC = 24.56 posted against 2026-10 for 3 months (the account is in grace and its automatic draft was returned in it, so the invoice issued last is collected with the grace-cure payment and every billed month is credited, less the one already credited); GCP = 317.62 after the credit. Factor traces, sensitivities and exact assembly arithmetic are in computations[] and the argument tracing of steps 10 and 12; baseline results 108.84 and 101.78.

[Round-2 revision log, by audit item; where the round-3 log below names the same mechanism, the round-3 text supersedes this one]
- C1 / T0-F1: VTC's and REC's overwrites of the same termination_unearned clause each name both their own case and the sibling's case (vision unit -> VTC, ended rider -> REC) and leave every other termination credit under the base rule.
- C4 / T0-F2 / T0-O3: GCP declares a scoped overwrite of "A payment is applied to the oldest unpaid coverage month first" for the grace-cure payment only: an earlier grace-cure check or transfer still inside the clearing hold is applied once it clears and is not counted. The held item is now the 20.00 check (check or transfer, the later one; check wins a same-day tie).
- C5: GCP's AutoPay-discount overwrite names past-due months and the not-yet-begun month of the invoice issued last, matching g_next tier 2 and g_disc tier 1.
- C6 / T0-F5: no factor reads another factor's binding and no plain binding reads a factor-owned binding (mechanical check in worklog.md); the interest base and booking args read the plain months-already-credited sum, so vtc_prior's sensitivity is the same by compute and by words; GCP's fee and relief read one shared windowed fee selection.
- C7: g_next tier 2 now adds only the forfeited AutoPay discount on the invoice issued last (a different input from tier 1's invoice amount), so the tiers never coincide; all-pairs table in worklog.md.
- C8(i) / T0-F3: the dental-tenure shortfall tolerance (g_tol) is removed; GCP keeps five factors, none invented around a tolerance.
- C9 / T0-F6: VTC carries compute bindings post_month and book_months for the booked coverage_month and months_covered, both stated by the rule sentence "The credit is posted against the coverage month of the invoice issued last, and its months covered are ..."; g_disc tier 1 tests the draft history plus the arrangement's discount; vtc_month counts drafts collected against automatic drafts returned; tie rules are stated for every selection.
- C10: the coverage window ends at the termination date, the termination request is the unit's own (scoped by vision_plan_id), the fee selection is windowed to the grace period, and an automatic draft is a returned bank draft that had paid a coverage month (months_covered 1), so the 2026-09-18 return of the one-time transfer is not one; probes in worklog.md.
- C11: prerequisite sentence rewritten to one posted credit.
- T0-O2: the benefit offset reads the household's services in the unit's coverage window, as the vision charter's plan unit covers all the subscriber's enrollments on the account.

[Careless paths] base termination reading (145.12 credit) or begun months only (20.54 credit) although October's invoice is collected with the cure; paying the past-due premium only (101.78); holding the returned 60.00 transfer; treating the 20.00 check as applied (297.62); leaving out the fees (267.62).

[Round-3 revision log, by audit item; where the round-4 log below names the same mechanism, the round-4 text supersedes this one]
- C9-r2 (i) / C13: 'billed on AutoPay' (vtc_month) and 'left AutoPay' (g_disc, g_fee) are read from the arrangement record: an AutoPay discount on the arrangement, or an arrangement that carries none and does not accept bank draft although regular automatic drafts were collected within twelve months (only the AutoPay arrangement the account was moved from could collect them). A Quarterly Bill or Annual Prepay account paying by eft no longer qualifies (probes in worklog.md).
- C9-r2 (ii): VTC's months covered are the months counted (new method factor vtc_window: prepaid / begun / billed) less the months already credited, so the booked months and the credited amount describe the same months.
- C9-r2 (iii): an automatic draft is a returned bank draft that paid one, three or twelve coverage months.
- C10-r2 (a): a grace-cure check or transfer whose same-method, same-amount return (one that paid no month) is dated on or after it is never held; here the 60.00 transfer is not held and the 20.00 check is.
- C10-r2 (b) / C12 / T0-R2-F1 / T0-R2-O1: vtc_feeback is removed (it gave back fees by count and asserted a cause no record shows). g_fee's tiers now follow the arrangement record (left AutoPay: fees booked within twelve months; no AutoPay discount otherwise: fees booked in the grace period; an arrangement that drafts: none, the next draft collects them), so no tier is a count split and each sums only fees actually booked.
- Draw kept: VTC 6 factors (vtc_window added), GCP 5.

[Round-4 revision log, by audit item]
- T0-R3-O1 (cross-policy): the vision credit's standard now counts the billed months that have begun, and its months factor counts every billed month when the account is in grace with its automatic draft returned in it — exactly the case in which the grace-cure payment collects the invoice issued last in full. The holder is no longer asked for October's vision premium without the credit for it; the prior 2026-07-08 credit is still what the rule gives on that date (one begun month).
- C10-r3: the held payment is found by taking the latest grace-cure check and the latest grace-cure transfer, setting aside one that a returned payment names as the payment it returns (original_billing_txn_id), never substituting an earlier one, and holding the later of those left; here the transfer is set aside by its return and the check is held.
- C3-r3 (charter): the invoice reading used by the dental and rider credits now also prices active and applied riders and a DHMO enrollment the account funds; no value moves in this task.

[Round-6 revision log, render pre-scan render_r1 findings 1-8]
- 1: the grace-cure fee tier for an arrangement without AutoPay discount now collects the returned-payment fee booked last when it counts as booked in the grace period (a two-date test), instead of a whole-month window that reached into the month before.
- 2, 3: the standing-relief windows of the grace-cure and renewal payments are stated exactly as measured (returned payments within the lookback no more than those within the whole-month window from the grace start / renewal invoice to the payment date plus one, anniversary-counted).
- 4: the invoice reading leaves out active riders applied for after the invoice's date as well as applied ones, and its scope sentence covers active and applied riders of each plan separately.
- 5: every months factor states that an account with no paid-through date is taken under the following cases.
- 6: the departed dependent is the subscriber's child, spouse or domestic partner (subscriber rows excluded), with the tie order stated; r_dental no longer carries the cross-difficulty flag because its dependent read is now a shared plain selection (the task keeps r_rider and r_vbinder).
- 7, 8: the invoice reading names the vision enrollment funded by the account and the tie rule for the subscriber's current dental tier.
- No scored value moved (recomputed: every expected value, baseline and factor sensitivity unchanged).

[Round-7 revision log, KB audit KB-B0-1 / SRC-1]
- The vision credit now says whose vision services count, in the vision charter's own terms: the unit is the plan unit of the terminated subscriber enrollment, every vision enrollment of the subscriber funded by the account (here Renata's, Tomas's, Lucia's and Mateo's), and the benefits paid are those on services of every enrollment in it. Because services are read from all of the subscriber's vision claims, the offset is taken only when every vision enrollment the subscriber holds is funded by the account; otherwise no offset is deducted. On this world every vision enrollment of the subscriber is funded by this account, so the household reading (420.00 against 290.24) is the stated one and no scored value moves.

[Round-8 revision log, C-r7-1]
- The vision credit's other-account guard now tests exactly what the rule says: the offset is skipped only when a vision enrollment of the subscriber funded by another account is applied or active, or ended by termination inside the unit's coverage window (measured as a service is); a cancelled one, or one that ended before the window, does not count. On this world no other-account enrollment exists, so no scored value moves.

[Round-9 revision log, C-r8-1 (coordinator decision)]
- The vision credit's other-account guard is now one coarse record test, stated verbatim and computed exactly: the benefit offset is taken only when no vision enrollment of the subscriber other than one whose status is cancelled has ever been funded by another billing account; otherwise no offset is deducted (a stated residue). The round-8 window/overlap wording is gone and supersedes nothing else. On this world every vision record of the subscriber is on this account, so no scored value moves.

[Round-10 revision log, C-r9-1 (text only)]
- The guard sentence now names exactly what the compute exempts: every vision enrollment whose status is cancelled (an application withdrawn before its start, an application cancelled for an unpaid binder, or a plan returned in the free-look period). Compute, world rows and values unchanged.

[Round-11 revision log, KB cross-product re-judge SRC-R3-1 / SRC-R3-3 (seed only)]
- SRC-R3-1: Lucia's and Mateo's frame reimbursements are re-priced at the vision docs' children's out-of-network frame amount (90.00 for a patient under 19), so the vision benefits paid in the unit's window are 420.00 and the early-cancellation offset 129.76. Scored values moved: the vision credit (to 24.56) and, through it, the grace-cure payment (to 317.62); every factor still bears weight and the edge still holds (skipping the credit gives 342.18). The 2026-07-08 prior credit is still what the rule gives on that date (10.00; the offset still absorbs the one billed month).
- SRC-R3-3: Lucia's active Child 1500 rider and Mateo's withdrawn application now carry the permitted start 2026-01-01 (the attached enrollment's next benefit-period start); the 2025-07 to 2025-12 invoices and their drafts are re-priced without the rider (106.66; 142.94 once vision starts), invoice and payment moving together, so no scored value moves from this item.

[Gates] EXTENDED, TASK TOOL CONTRACT, REPLAY, SOLVABILITY, COMPUTE, GROUNDING, SCOPE: all OK on the round-2 world.
user_scenario:
You are Renata Quiroga, a school bus dispatcher in Tacoma who handles the family's insurance bills herself. You are calling on your lunch break, a little embarrassed and in a hurry, because a letter from Cascade Mutual Dental & Vision says your account is in a grace period and that automatic draft has been taken off it. You know why: you moved your paycheck to a new credit union at the end of August and the September automatic bank draft from your old checking account bounced. The draft that bounced was a little over a hundred and fifty dollars. Your goal is simple and you say it early: you want to pay, today, by card, whatever Cascade needs from you to bring the account out of the grace period so your family's dental coverage and your daughter Lucia's orthodontic coverage do not lapse. You want to make that card payment yourself.

To be found, you give your phone number, 3605550142. When the representative asks you to confirm who you are, you give your date of birth, April 17, 1983 (1983-04-17), and your ZIP code, 98406; you give the other details only if asked again. If asked for your member ID it is CMD7426518, read off the card. You do not know your account's internal reference numbers and expect the representative to look them up.

You do not know the amount you owe and you never offer a figure of your own beyond the bounced draft being a bit over a hundred and fifty dollars. If the representative asks whether you have paid anything since the draft bounced, you say yes: on September 15 you paid sixty dollars online from the old checking account, which bounced too, and on September 19 you mailed a check for twenty dollars from the new credit union as a start. If the representative brings up the family's vision plan, you say you cancelled it in June because your husband Tomas's new job gives the family vision coverage, and you had assumed the bills stopped including it; the family had seen an eye doctor outside Cascade's network while it lasted and sent the receipts in. You do not raise the vision plan yourself. If the representative explains that something on the account has to be corrected or booked before the payment can be worked out, you agree right away and let them do it, saying something like "go ahead, I'd rather it be right."

When the representative tells you the amount to pay, you ask once, in your own words, what it covers. Whatever the explanation is, you accept it and do not argue the figure or suggest a different one. When the representative gives you the payment step to complete yourself, you complete it with the account reference and the exact amount the representative gives you, paying by card. When you see the confirmation of your card payment, you repeat the confirmation number back once, thank the representative, and end the call. You do not ask for anything else: you do not ask for a refund, for the bounced payments to be retried, for your automatic draft to be set up again, or for anything to be mailed to you.

temporal_feasibility.condition: A group may report a member's termination retroactively, but a retro_termination credit may be given only for coverage months that begin within the retro termination limit before the date the group reported the termination; earlier months stay billed.

temporal_basis.counting_rule: The retro limit is retro_termination_limit_days counted back in calendar days from the date the termination is reported, and a month whose first day falls on or after the resulting date can be credited.

boundary_check.just_before: The retro limit governs retro_termination credits reported by a group; this credit is a termination_unearned credit on an individual account, so no coverage month of it is limited: under a group reading with a 60-day limit counted back from 2026-09-22, a month beginning 2026-07-23 or earlier could not be credited.
boundary_check.at_boundary: Under the same group reading a month beginning exactly on 2026-07-24 (60 calendar days back, inclusive) could still be credited; the credit reason here is not retro_termination, so the gate holds.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.billing_account_id: Value 33e3ddd3-a93e-4cdd-8d41-16e36afb4d64. Basis: the tool docstring says the reference number is the premium billing account 'as returned by the billing-account lookup for the customer', and find_billing_accounts returned exactly one account. argument_uniqueness_tracing.coverage_month: Value 2026-10. Basis: billing_ext_vision_term_credit rule: 'The credit is posted against the coverage month of the invoice issued last'. The invoice issued last is b2dc4f8e (issued 2026-09-11, coverage_month 2026-10); no other invoice is dated 2026-09-11. Uniqueness: one latest invoice, one coverage month.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.months_covered: Value 3. Basis: the rule: 'its months covered are the months counted above less the months already credited, never fewer than zero'. The account is in a grace period and its automatic draft (2026-09-01, which had paid 2026-09) was returned 2026-09-11, on/after the grace start 2026-09-01, so the invoice issued last is collected with the grace-cure payment and every month billed after the termination month counts: MONTHS(2026-06-30, 2026-10-01) + 1 = 3 + 1 = 4 (2026-07..2026-10); months already credited = the 1 month of the 2026-07-08 vision termination credit; 4 - 1 = 3.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.credit_amount: Value 24.56. Standard: filed premium 36.28 (Select 130, family) x the billed months after 2026-06 that have begun (MONTHS(2026-06-30, 2026-09-22) + 1 = 3, no more than the 4 billed) = 108.84. Factors: vtc_month (parameter) - the months were billed on AutoPay: the arrangement now is Direct Bill, which carries no AutoPay discount and does not accept bank draft, yet 12 regular automatic drafts were collected within 12 months -> 36.28 - 1.00/3 plan units (dental, vision, 1 active rider) = 35.946667; vtc_window (method) - account in grace with its automatic draft returned 2026-09-11, on/after the grace start -> every billed month counts, 4 (2026-07..2026-10); vtc_offset (method, vision) - coverage months MONTHS(2025-11-01, 2026-06-30) + 1 = 8 <= 12 and out-of-network reimbursements in the coverage window 420.00 (exams 45 x 5 + lenses 30 x 2 + frames 90 x 2 = 465.00, less the 45.00 reversal) > 36.28 x 8 = 290.24 -> offset 129.76; vtc_prior (parameter) - the 2026-07-08 vision termination credit 10.00 -> deduct 10.00; vtc_int (parameter) - DAYS(2026-06-30, 2026-09-22) = 84 > 30 and <= 90 -> 10 percent a year on 36.28 x 1 paid uncredited month (MONTHS(2026-06-30, 2026-08-31) = 2 less 1 credited) x 54/365 = 0.536745; vtc_recover (parameter) - the unit's confirmed request registered 2026-06-08, 22 days before the termination date (>= 20 invoice lead days), 4 months billed (>= 3) -> 20.00. Assembly: MX(0, 35.946667 x 4 - 129.76 - 10.00) = 4.026667, plus 0.536745 and 20.00 = 24.563412, rounded half up once = 24.56.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.payment_amount: Value 317.62. Standard: premium past due for begun months = invoices 2356.32 + returned payments 216.34 - payments 2279.98 - credits 34.56 (10.00 + the 24.56 booked at step 10) - the 2026-10 invoice 156.34 (not yet begun) = 101.78. Factors: g_next (method) - automatic draft that had paid a month returned 2026-09-11, on/after the grace start 2026-09-01, and the latest invoice is for 2026-10 (not begun) -> add 156.34 in full; g_disc (parameter) - two bank-draft returns within 12 months (2026-09-11, 2026-09-18) and the account left AutoPay (Direct Bill: no AutoPay discount, no bank draft accepted, yet 12 regular automatic drafts collected within 12 months) -> 2 x 1.00 = 2.00; g_fee (parameter) - the account left AutoPay -> every returned-payment fee booked within 12 months, 25.00 (2026-09-11) + 25.00 (2026-09-18) = 50.00; g_relief (parameter) - no return before the grace period within 24 months (2 within 24 months = 2 within the grace window), opened 2022-06-14 = 51 whole months (36..59), fee booked last 2026-09-18 in the grace period -> 50 percent of 25.00 = 12.50 deducted; g_hold (parameter, decides the held amount) - a payment returned 4 days before the payment date (<= 60) -> 10-day hold; of the latest grace-cure check (20.00, 2026-09-19) and the latest grace-cure transfer (60.00, 2026-09-15), the transfer is set aside because the 2026-09-18 return names it as the payment returned, and the check, which no return names, is held (3 days old) -> added back 20.00. Assembly: MX(0, 101.78 + 156.34 + 2.00 + 50.00 + 20.00 - 12.50) = 317.62, rounded half up = 317.62.
